title: Living at Arthur Young's Institute for the Study of Consciousness
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Living at Arthur Young's Institute for the Study of Consciousness, about 1970s at Berkeley, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Institute for the Study of Consciousness, Berkeley

tellings.quote: he showed up in my life and invited me to live with him to move into the institute for the study of consciousness he had set up in Berkeley.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic experience who earned a PhD on the subject, says that in the 1970s the inventor and thinker Arthur Young came into his life and invited him to live with him. He says he moved into the Institute for the Study of Consciousness, a center Young had set up in Berkeley, California, and he tells it as a turning point in his path into studying the mind.
